title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR 2 open — natural union with Adam is foundation of the imputation at issue
pass_a_gloss: GAR opens a second head: natural union with Adam is not only granted but called the foundation of the imputation in dispute.
pass_b_english: GAR. 2. We not only acknowledge a natural union with Adam, but also say that it is the foundation of that imputation which is under discussion.
source_text: GAR. 2. Unionem cum Adamo naturalem non tantum agnoscimus, sed etiam imputationis illius, de qua agitur, fundamentum esse dicimus.

choices.choice: Natural union = foundation of disputed imputation

notes: Cap. IX GAR Resp.1 densify section 609 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 347–348 tip).
